fields.result: PASS under make check at commit dea942b on branch m2-cs9-carve
fields.statement: Go tests and testscripts show a carve making the source depend on the target when ops left in the source, or in an in-flight change set depending on it directly or transitively, rest on a moved node or link; refusing a carve whose needed dependency would close a cycle; and no false dropped conflict for a dependent when a moved node still exists under the same ID, including when the carve leaves the source empty. Known limit: a dependent's op whose base names a moved op still gets a base conflict.
fields.tests: go test: TestCarve/ChildLeftBehind, TestCarve/DependentRests, TestCarve/TransitiveDependentRests, TestCarve/DependentRestsOnNothingMoved, TestCarveRefused/Cycle, TestCarveRefused/DependentCycle (internal/api), TestRevisedRecreated (internal/changeset); testscript: carve-children.txtar, carve-dependents.txtar (incl. emptied source E with dependent G's bkid under moved p), carve-guards.txtar
